findings.F1: The main measure is on the side the idea predicts but just short of the bar: the mean unusual 48-hour move is +0.37 % per case with t 1.96 over 1,687 Monday cases, a strength of 0.052 of the coin's usual 6.56 % move, which is the usual size of a real idea.
findings.F2: The effect is not confined to some coins. It is positive in every one of the six: BTC +0.25 % (t 1.08, 282 cases), ETH +0.45 % (t 1.39, 282), LTC +0.37 % (t 0.98, 282), XMR +0.33 % (t 0.98, 279), XRP +0.46 % (t 0.88, 282) and ZEC +0.34 % (t 0.85, 280). The test is short of cases, not short of a part where the effect shows.
findings.F4: The horizon the plan chose is where the effect is clearest.
findings.F5: Neither one side nor the largest forecasts carry the effect.
findings.F6: Per case, the total move of +0.40 % is 2.1 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade. A clear answer on more cases is worth having, even though the book (Sharpe 0.73, mean daily return 0.028 %) fell short of the profitability bar.

ideas.name: turbulent weekends continue, more coins
ideas.idea: When a coin's hourly moves over the weekend (Saturday 00:00 to Monday 00:00 UTC) were more volatile than over its previous week, the coin keeps moving in the direction of its weekend return over the next 2 days. The continuation is larger the higher the weekend's volatility compared with the previous week.
ideas.consequence: A trader should refuse to fade a weekend move made on turbulent trading, and may follow its direction over Monday and Tuesday, more so the more turbulent the weekend was.
